text: July CPI rises 0.1% monthly and 3.4% annually; core CPI rises 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annually. Energy falls 1.5% for the month while remaining 14.7% higher annually. Shelter rises 0.1%, accounting for about two-thirds of the headline monthly increase.

meta.note: Monthly and annual readings operate at different temporal layers and remain directionally distinct.

text: Truth API sells machine-readable access to publicly available posts from Trump and other government accounts for $60,000-$100,000 monthly. The Intercept Media and Freedom of the Press Association filed suit challenging preferential access to posts that include government announcements.

meta.note: The disputed access advantage is measured in delivery speed rather than exclusive underlying content.

text: Karoline Leavitt will leave the White House press secretary role by the end of August after serving since January 2025. Trump states that Leavitt will remain an outside advisor and work with the Republican Party during the 2026 midterm election period.

meta.note: The successor to the press secretary role is not identified.
